title: Prepare bodies only in a complying mortuary
what: Embalm or otherwise prepare bodies for burial or cremation only in a mortuary that meets the mortuary standards, unless the Secretary approves other premises.

sources.title: Public Health Regulation 2022 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not, without the approval of the Secretary, use any premises other than a mortuary that complies with the relevant standards for mortuaries under the Local Government Act 1993 for the embalming or other preparation of bodies for burial or cremation or for the placing of bodies in coffins for burial or cremation

administration.who: Secretary under the Public Health Act 2010 (NSW Health)

sources.title: Public Health Regulation 2022 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.locator: s 111, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026)
sources.quote: A person who operates a mortuary must give the Secretary written notice of the following— (a) the name and location of the mortuary, (b) the name and address of the person who operates the mortuary, (c) the telephone number of the mortuary or of the person who operates the mortuary, (d) the name and address of any funeral director who has access to the mortuary.

reach.condition: if it prepares bodies for burial or cremation (a funeral director)
